infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SafeBro uses the microphone for audio and video recordings you start, and for Voice Trigger while armed.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SafeBro uses the camera for recordings you start.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SafeBro listens for your chosen voice trigger only while Voice Trigger is visibly armed.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SafeBro lets you attach selected photos to recordings you create.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SafeBro uses location during a trip you record to show speed and store route points locally.
